description: This file contains legacy (deprecated) batching rule implementations for PyTorch's functorch module, including functions for handling batched tensors, such as as_strided, squeeze, unsqueeze, transpose, and batch-aware versions of split, cat, block_diag, stack, and new_empty_strided. It also registers these batching rules with the PyTorch dispatcher for the legacy API.

methods.name: is_allowed_dim_on_scalar_tensor
methods.description: Checks if a dimension is allowed on a scalar tensor (dim 0 or -1).

methods.name: get_current_level
methods.description: Retrieves the current dynamic batching level.

methods.name: participatesInCurrentLevel
methods.description: Checks if a tensor or list of tensors participates in the current batching level.

methods.name: squeeze_dims__batching_rule
methods.description: Batching rule for squeeze with dims argument.

methods.name: squeeze_dim__batching_rule
methods.description: Batching rule for squeeze with a single dimension.

methods.name: squeeze__batching_rule
methods.description: Batching rule for squeeze without dims.

methods.name: split_with_sizes_batching_rule
methods.description: Batching rule for split with sizes.

methods.name: split_with_sizes_copy_batching_rule
methods.description: Batching rule for split with sizes copy.

methods.name: nested_cat_batching_rule
methods.description: Batching rule for nested tensor cat.
